No — unlike a Western sign such as [Virgo](/virgo-dates/), whose date range barely shifts, the Chinese new year ranges between January 21 and February 20 depending on the lunar cycle. 1994's fell on February 10; 1993's landed January 23, both fixed by Hong Kong's official conversion charts for those years.
